DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この列の収穫が済んだら、かごを出す前に色を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pagkatapos anihin ang hanay na ito, tingnan po ang kulay bago ilabas ang basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つだけまだ黄色いトマトが入っています。赤い物と一緒に出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色いトマトが混ざったと報告し赤い物と出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: May isang kamatis pong dilaw pa. Puwede bang isama sa pulang ilalabas?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Iulat ang dilaw na kamatis at itanong kung puwedeng kasama ng pula. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それはこのかごには入れません。まず傷がないか見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi po sa basket na ito. Pakita muna kung may gasgas.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表面は傷ついていませんが、へたの近くも黄色いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 傷はないがへた付近も黄色いと状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Wala pong gasgas sa balat pero dilaw din malapit sa tangkay.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na walang gasgas ngunit dilaw pati sa tangkay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 熟し具合を確認する物として分けましょう。あちらの空のかごに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ihiwalay po para suriin ang pagkahinog. Ilagay sa bakanteng basket doon.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 空のかごが二つあります。札の付いていないほうを使うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二つの空かごのうち札のない物を使うのか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dalawa po ang bakante. Iyong walang tag ang gagamitin?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung walang tag ang gagamiting isa sa dalawang basket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 札のないほうです。私が確認するまで、出荷用のかごとは離して置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, walang tag. Ihiwalay sa basket ng pagpapadala hanggang masuri ko.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分けたかごには、未確認だとわかる札も付けたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未確認のトマトに識別用の札を付けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dapat din bang lagyan ng tag ang inihiwalay para malamang hindi pa nasusuri?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang tag para sa hindi pa nasuri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうですね。「確認待ち」と書いた札を付けましょう。ほかにも色の薄い物があれば知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, lagyan ng naghihintay ng pagsusuri. Sabihin kung may iba pang maputlang kulay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確認待ちの札を付けて、残りのかごにも薄い色の物がないか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 確認待ちの札を付け残りも色を点検すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Lalagyan ko po ng tag at titingnan din kung may maputla sa natitirang basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Lagyan ng hintay na tag at suriin ang kulay ng natitira. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 助かります。収穫に戻る前に声をかけてくださいね、お疲れ様です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Malaking tulong po. Sabihan ako bago bumalik sa pag-ani. Salamat sa trabaho.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お取り寄せの問題集が届いています。ご注文のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dumating na po ang ipinahanap ninyong workbook. Ano po ang pangalan sa order?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: グエンです。日本語の問題集を頼んだのですが、表紙に旧版と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文名を伝え問題集の表紙が旧版だと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nguyen po. Japanese workbook ang inorder ko pero lumang edisyon ang nasa pabalat.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pangalan at lumang edisyon sa pabalat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: グエン様ですね。ご注文の控えを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nguyen po. Maaari bang makita ang kopya ng order?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この控えです。注文するときは、改訂版を希望したつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文控えを見せ改訂版を希望したつもりだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ito po. Ang balak ko noong umorder ay revised edition.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang kopya at sabihing revised ang balak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 控えには旧版の番号が入っています。改訂版をご希望でしたら在庫を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Lumang edisyon po ang numero sa kopya. Kung revised ang gusto, titingnan ang stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受け取る前に確認したいです。改訂版は音声をスマートフォンで聞ける物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 受取前に改訂版のスマートフォン用音声を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Gusto kong tiyakin bago tanggapin. May audio ba ang revised na mapapakinggan sa smartphone?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang smartphone audio bago tanggapin ang revised. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 商品説明では音声をダウンロードする版ですね。旧版は付属のディスクを使う説明になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ayon po sa detalye, ida-download ang audio sa edisyong iyon. Disc na kasama ang gamit sa luma.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家にディスクを使える機械がないので、改訂版に注文を変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ディスク機器がないため改訂版への注文変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Wala po akong makinang gumagamit ng disc sa bahay. Maaari bang palitan ang order sa revised?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Walang disc player kaya humiling ng palit sa revised. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 変更の扱いと取り寄せ日数を確認します。まだお会計はせず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Titiyakin po ang paraan ng pagpapalit at ilang araw ang pag-order. Huwag munang magbayad at dito maghintay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 支払いを待って、変更できるかと届く日を聞いてから受け取りを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 変更可否と到着日を聞くまで支払いと受取を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Hindi muna ako magbabayad at magpapasya sa pagkuha matapos malaman kung puwede ang palit at kailan darating.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Maghintay sa bayad at pagkuha hanggang malaman ang palit at dating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承りました。こちらの椅子へどうぞ、お待ちいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sige po. Sa upuang ito muna at salamat sa paghihintay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本の線を書けましたね。どの線がいちばん難しかったですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Naisulat po ang tatlong linya. Alin ang pinakamahirap?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 真ん中の線が右に寄ってしまいました。筆を動かす向きが違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 真ん中の線が右に寄ると伝え筆の動く向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Napunta po sa kanan ang gitnang linya. Mali ba ang direksiyon ng brush?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na pakanan ang gitna at itanong ang galaw ng brush. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 向きだけでなく、紙の位置も見ましょう。体の正面に紙を置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tingnan din po ang puwesto ng papel bukod sa direksiyon. Nasa harap po ba mismo ng katawan?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紙を少し右に置いていました。真ん中に動かしてから書き直してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紙が右にあったと説明し正面に直して書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Medyo nasa kanan po. Ililipat ko sa gitna at susubukang isulat ulit.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na nasa kanan ang papel at ilipat sa harap bago isulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いいですね。今度は筆先を見るだけでなく、線の終わりの位置も意識してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mabuti po. Ngayon, huwag lang ang dulo ng brush; isipin din ang lugar ng dulo ng linya.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 終わりまで一気に引くのですか。それとも、途中で止めて向きを確かめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 線を一気に引くか途中で止めるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isang tuloy-tuloy po ba hanggang dulo? O hihinto sa gitna para tiyakin ang direksiyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong kung tuloy-tuloy o hinto sa gitna ang linya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まずはゆっくり一筆で引いてみましょう。私が横で手の動きを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Subukan po muna ang isang mabagal na stroke. Nasa tabi ako para tingnan ang kamay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本とも書く前に、真ん中の線だけ別の紙で練習してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三本を書き直す前に真ん中の線だけ練習したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Bago po isulat lahat ng tatlo, puwede bang gitnang linya lang muna sa ibang papel?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Humiling ng gitnang linya lang na praktis bago ang tatlo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もちろんです。練習用の紙をこちらに置きますね。納得できたら一枚に三本を書きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Siyempre po. Dito ang practice paper. Kapag nasiyahan, tatlong linya sa isang papel.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 別の紙でまっすぐ引く感覚をつかんでから、「川」を一枚に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 別紙で直線を練習してから「川」を一枚に書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Kukunin ko po ang pakiramdam ng tuwid sa ibang papel bago isulat ang kawa na ilog sa isang papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Magsanay ng tuwid sa iba at saka kawa sa isang papel. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 焦らず試してください。それでは、練習を楽しんでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Huwag magmadali. Masiyahan po sa pagsasanay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その小鉢は二つで一組にすることもできます。いくつお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede ring gawing pares ang maliliit na mangkok. Ilan po?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ形を二つください。電車で帰るので、重ねずに包んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小鉢二つを電車で運ぶため重ねずに包んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dalawa po na parehong hugis. Tren ang pauwi ko, kaya pakibalot nang hindi pinagpapatong.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Humiling ng dalawang mangkok na hindi patong para sa tren. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つずつ紙で包んで、間に緩衝材を入れましょう。手提げ袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isa-isa pong papel at cushion sa pagitan. Kailangan din po ba ng hand-carry bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: リュックに入れるつもりですが、小鉢が動かない箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: リュック内で小鉢が動かない箱の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sa backpack po sana. May kahon ba para hindi gumalaw ang mangkok?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kahong hindi gagalaw sa backpack. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小箱なら二つ入ります。中のすき間も紙で埋めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kasya po ang dalawa sa maliit na kahong ito. Pupunuin din ng papel ang puwang.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 箱代を含めるといくらになりますか。予算は三千円までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予算三千円を示し箱込みの合計額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Magkano po kasama ang kahon? Hanggang tatlong libong yen ang budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang tatlong libong budget at itanong ang kahon kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小鉢二つが二千四百円で、箱は二百円です。合計二千六百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dalawang libo at apat na raan po ang dalawa at dalawang daan ang kahon, dalawang libo at anim na raan lahat.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その金額なら箱もお願いします。上に重い物を載せないようにすればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二千六百円で箱を頼み上に重い物を載せないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sa halagang iyon, kahon na rin po. Huwag lang patungan ng mabigat, tama po ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Humiling ng kahon sa dalawang libo at anim na raan at huwag patungan ng mabigat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、箱がつぶれない位置に入れてください。包んだあと、中で動かないか私も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, ilagay sa hindi madudurog na puwesto. Titingnan ko rin kung hindi gumagalaw sa loob matapos balutin.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 箱はリュックの上側に入れて、飲み物のボトルは別の袋で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 箱をリュック上側に入れボトルを別袋で運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sa itaas po ng backpack ang kahon at hiwalay na bag ang bote ng inumin.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ilagay sa itaas ng backpack at hiwalay na bag ang bote. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 丁寧に運んでくださってありがとうございます。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Salamat sa maingat na pagdadala. Ingat po sa pag-uwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 串焼きをお持ちしました。こちらに置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ito na po ang inihaw na tusok. Ilalagay ko rito.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三人で一本ずつ食べるつもりですが、二本しかありません。注文は三本で通っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三人用の串が二本しかないと伝え三本の注文を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tig-isang tusok po sana kaming tatlo pero dalawa lang. Tatlo po ba ang pumasok na order?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na dalawa lang para sa tatlo at tiyakin ang tatlong order. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 伝票を確かめますね。ご注文は鶏の串焼き三本でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Titingnan po ang slip. Tatlong chicken skewer po ang order?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、鶏を三本です。ほかの種類の串は頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鶏三本でほかの種類は頼んでいないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, tatlong manok. Wala kaming ibang uri ng tusok na inorder.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Linawin na tatlong manok at walang ibang uri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 伝票にも三本とあります。厨房に残り一本の状況を聞いてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tatlo rin po sa slip. Itatanong sa kusina ang natitirang isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この二本は先に食べても構いませんか。全部そろうまで待つ必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 届いた二本を先に食べてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede bang kainin muna ang dalawang ito? O kailangang hintaying makumpleto?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong kung makakain muna ang dalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先に召し上がっていただいて大丈夫です。残りの一本は焼き上がりまで五分ほどと聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede po. Mga limang minuto pa ang natitira bago matapos lutuin.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では二本は先に分けます。あと一本が届くとき、小皿も一枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二本を分けると伝え追加の小皿を一枚頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Paghahatian muna po ang dalawa. Maaari bang isang maliit na plato rin pagdating ng isa?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Hatiin muna ang dalawa at humiling ng isang maliit na plato. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小皿は今お持ちしますね。残りの串も、焼き上がったら私がお届けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dadalhin ko po ngayon ang plato. Ako rin ang magdadala ng isa kapag luto.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。小皿で分けて食べながら、残り一本を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 小皿で先に食べながら残り一本を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Salamat po. Hahatiin sa maliit na plato at kakain habang hinihintay ang isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Kumain sa maliit na plato habang hinihintay ang isa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お待たせして申し訳ありません。どうぞ先にお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Paumanhin po sa paghihintay. Kainin na po muna.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この畝は手で摘みます。見本の枝を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pipitasin po sa kamay ang hanay na ito. Tingnan nating dalawa ang halimbawang sanga.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 枝の先に小さい葉が三枚あります。三枚とも摘むのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枝先の三枚の葉をすべて摘むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: May tatlong maliit na dahon po sa dulo. Lahat ng tatlo ba ang pipitasin?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung lahat ng tatlong dahon sa dulo ang pipitasin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はこの柔らかい部分を摘み、下の大きな葉は残します。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Malambot pong bahaging ito ang pipitasin ngayon at iiwan ang malalaking dahon sa ibaba.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本より葉が硬い枝もありますが、それも同じ籠に入れますか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 硬い葉も同じ籠に入れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: May mas matigas pong dahon sa ibang sanga kaysa halimbawa. Sa parehong basket din ba iyon?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung kasama sa basket ang matigas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 硬いものは摘まず、私に場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag pong pitasin ang matigas at sabihin sa akin ang puwesto.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この曲がった枝は残して、柔らかい先端だけ集めます。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がった枝を残し柔らかい先端を集める方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iiwan ko po ang baluktot na sangang ito at malambot na dulo lang ang kukunin.
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iwan ang baluktot na sanga at kunin ang malambot na dulo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その分け方でお願いします。摘んだ葉を強く押し込まないでください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ganoon po. Huwag idiin nang malakas ang napitas sa basket.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 籠が半分ほど埋まったら、どこへ運べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 半分埋まった籠の運搬先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Saan po dadalhin kapag mga kalahati na ang laman?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang dadalhan ng kalahating basket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 畝の端の日陰へ置いて、空の籠に替えましょう。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa lilim sa dulo ng hanay at palitan ng walang lamang basket.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日陰までの道にホースがあるので、通り道を確かめてから運びます。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ホースのある通り道を確認して運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: May hose po sa daan sa lilim kaya titiyakin ko muna ang daanan bago magdala.
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang daang may hose bago magdala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 私もホースの位置を見ておきます。では、気をつけて行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titingnan ko rin po ang hose. Mag-ingat po sa pagpunta.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 帽子を押さえていらっしゃいますね。風が強くなってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hinahawakan po ninyo ang sumbrero. Lumalakas ang hangin.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 景色を見る前に少し休みたいです。風を避けられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 風を避けて休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Gusto ko pong magpahinga bago tingnan ang tanawin. May lugar na iwas sa hangin?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pahingahang iwas sa hangin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付横の屋内に椅子があります。外のベンチは今、風が当たります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: May upuan po sa loob sa tabi ng reception. Mahangin ngayon sa bangko sa labas.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 屋内からも山が見えますか。外へ出るか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 屋内から山が見えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kita rin po ba ang bundok mula sa loob? Nag-iisip ako kung lalabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung kita ang bundok mula sa loob. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 窓から一部は見えます。無理に外へ出なくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: May bahagi pong kita sa bintana. Hindi kailangang piliting lumabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず窓から眺めます。写真を撮るとき、窓際に立ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 窓から眺める方針と窓際での撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sa bintana po muna ako titingin. Puwede bang tumayo sa tabi kapag kukuha ng litrato?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na sa bintana muna at itanong ang litrato doon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通路を空ければ構いませんが、椅子の上には立たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede po kung maluwag ang daanan pero huwag tumayo sa upuan.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 椅子は動かさず、通る人がいないときに一枚だけ撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 椅子を動かさず通行人がいない時に撮ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi ko po gagalawin ang upuan at isang litrato lang kapag walang dumaraan.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Huwag galawin ang upuan at kumuha kapag walang dumaraan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。帰りはこの廊下を戻ると入口に出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo. Sa pabalik, sundin ang pasilyong ito papuntang entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 風が収まるのを待たず、屋内で休んでから入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 屋内で休んでから入口へ戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Hindi ko na po hihintaying humina ang hangin; magpapahinga sa loob at babalik sa entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pahinga sa loob at balik sa entrance. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: そのまま屋内の廊下をご利用ください。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Gamitin po ang pasilyo sa loob. Ingat sa pag-uwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この部屋では、昔の暮らしに使った道具を展示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nasa silid pong ito ang mga gamit sa pamumuhay noon.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 真ん中の四角い場所は囲炉裏ですか。料理にも使ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 囲炉裏かどうかと料理への用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Irori po ba ang parisukat sa gitna? Ginamit din ba sa pagluluto?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong kung irori at gamit sa pagluluto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。暖を取るほか、鍋を掛けて煮炊きする用途もありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, pampainit at pansabit ng kaldero para magluto.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 上から下がっている棒は、鍋の高さを変えるための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 吊るした棒が鍋の高さ調整用か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ang nakabiting bar po ba ay para baguhin ang taas ng kaldero?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong kung para sa taas ng kaldero ang nakabiting bar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: これは自在鉤と呼びます。この模型で高さの調整を説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Jizaikagi po ang tawag. Maipapaliwanag ang pagtaas at pagbaba sa modelong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示物に触らず、模型で動かし方を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 展示物に触らず説明用模型の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Maaari po bang ipakita sa modelo nang hindi hinahawakan ang display?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Huwag hawakan ang display at humiling ng demonstrasyon sa modelo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの説明用模型なら私が動かします。天井の色にも注目してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ako po ang magpapagalaw sa paliwanag na modelong ito. Pansinin din ang kulay ng kisame.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 天井が黒っぽいのは古いからですか、それとも煙の影響ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黒い天井と煙の関係を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Maitim po ang kisame dahil luma o epekto ng usok?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang usok at itim na kisame. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この解説では、囲炉裏の煙によるすすについて紹介しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ipinapaliwanag po rito ang uling-usok mula sa irori.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 先に解説を読みます。撮影できるかは入口の表示を見て確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 解説を読み撮影可否を表示で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Babasahin ko po muna. Titiyakin ko sa karatula sa entrance kung puwedeng kumuha ng litrato.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Basahin ang paliwanag at tiyakin ang litrato sa karatula. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 解説の続きは隣の部屋です。どうぞごゆっくり、次の展示もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Nasa katabing silid po ang kasunod na paliwanag. Tingnan nang malaya at masiyahan din sa susunod na eksibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 振込の入力についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: May problema po sa paglalagay ng bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 請求書は大家さんの名前なのに、画面には会社名が出ました。まだ送金していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 請求書と画面の名義が異なり未送金だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pangalan po ng landlord ang nasa invoice pero kumpanya ang nasa screen. Hindi pa ako nagpapadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin na magkaiba ang invoice at screen at wala pang padala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 名義が違う理由は銀行では判断できません。振込の確定前に相手へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi po matitiyak ng bangko kung bakit magkaiba ang pangalan. Itanong muna sa kausap bago kumpirmahin.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 電話をする間、この入力画面をそのままにしておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 電話確認中に入力画面を残せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede bang iwan ang input screen na ito habang tumatawag ako?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng iwan ang screen habang tumatawag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 長く離れる場合は操作を終了してください。口座番号は請求書で確認し直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kung matagal lalayo, tapusin po ang operasyon. Matitingnan ulit ang account number sa invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いったん終了します。相手には会社名義の口座でよいか尋ねればいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 操作を終了し会社名義口座の可否を相手に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tatapusin ko po muna. Itatanong ko kung tama ang account na pangalan ng kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tapusin ang operasyon at itanong ang kumpanya na account. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。支店、口座番号、名義をまとめて照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, sabay na itugma ang branch, numero at pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認が取れなければ、今日の振込は見送ります。手数料もまだ発生していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 確認できなければ見送り手数料の発生状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kung hindi matiyak, hindi po ako magpapadala ngayon. Wala pa ring bayad na fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Huwag tumuloy kung hindi tiyak at itanong ang fee. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 取引の状態を確認しますね。この画面では振込は確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Titiyakin po ang kalagayan ng transaksiyon. Sa screen na ito, hindi pa kumpirmado ang transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確定していないと分かりました。大家さんに連絡してから改めて手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 未確定を理解し大家に連絡後に手続きすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Naiintindihan ko pong hindi pa kumpirmado. Kokontakin ko muna ang landlord bago magproseso ulit.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi pa kumpirmado at kontakin ang landlord bago ulitin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 請求書をお忘れなく。ご確認後にまたご相談ください、本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Huwag po kalimutan ang invoice. Kumonsulta ulit matapos tiyakin. Salamat po sa araw na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 帯をお探しでしょうか。合わせる浴衣はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Obi po ba ang hanap? May yukata na pong itatambal?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紺色の浴衣を持っています。自分で結びやすい帯を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紺の浴衣に合う自分で結びやすい帯を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: May navy blue po akong yukata. Gusto ko ng obi na madaling itali nang sarili.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Humiling ng madaling itali para sa navy yukata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは柔らかい半幅帯で、結び方の見本もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Malambot pong hanhaba obi ito at may halimbawa ng pagtali.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真では黄色が合いそうですが、実際に紺の布と並べて見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色い帯と紺の実物見本の比較を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mukhang bagay po ang dilaw sa litrato, pero maaari bang itabi sa aktuwal na navy na tela?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipaghambing ang dilaw at aktuwal na navy na tela. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この紺の見本布で色合いを比べましょう。白い帯も横に置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ihambing po sa navy na halimbawa. Itatabi ko rin ang puting obi.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 黄色のほうが好みです。帯と結ぶ練習用の小物で五千円以内になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色を選び帯と練習小物が五千円以内か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mas gusto ko po ang dilaw. Kasya ba sa limang libong yen ang obi at maliliit na gamit sa pagsasanay ng pagtali?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Piliin ang dilaw at itanong ang obi at gamit sa limang libo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 値札の合計を確認します。この帯は四千円で、今日は小物なしでも結び方を試せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Titingnan po ang kabuuan ng tag. Apat na libo ang obi at puwede nang subukan ngayon ang pagtali nang walang ibang gamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では帯だけにします。ほどけにくくする結び方を一度見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 帯だけを購入しほどけにくい結び方の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Obi lang po kung ganoon. Maaari bang ipakita minsan ang taling hindi madaling makalas?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Obi lang at ipakita ang hindi madaling makalas na tali. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見本で説明しますね。最後に端を整えるところまでゆっくり見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ipapakita po sa halimbawa. Tingnan nang mabagal hanggang sa huling pag-aayos ng dulo.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 端の整え方が分かりました。家でも見本の写真を見ながら練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 端の整え方を理解し自宅で写真を参考に練習すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Naintindihan ko na po ang dulo. Magsasanay din sa bahay habang tinitingnan ang litrato ng halimbawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Sabihin na naunawaan ang dulo at magsasanay sa bahay gamit ang litrato. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 帯を包みますね。どうぞ浴衣でのお出かけを楽しんでください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Ibabalot ko po ang obi. Masiyahan sa paglabas na naka-yukata at salamat.
